title: Conflict Resolution and Replanning
prompt: Replan the launch work given the current memory state. State whether launch should proceed, who owns what, and what must happen first.
prompt_zh: 请根据当前记忆状态重规划发布工作，说明现在是否应该继续发布、每项工作由谁负责，以及哪些步骤必须先完成。

title: Risk and Blocker Analysis
prompt: List the most important blockers, risks, and unresolved issues affecting the launch.
prompt_zh: 请列出当前影响发布的关键阻塞项、主要风险和仍未解决的问题。

title: Decision Consistency Audit
prompt: Judge whether it is consistent with the meeting to publish the announcement this week and launch on the original date.
prompt_zh: 请判断“本周对外发公告并按原定日期发布”是否与会议结论一致。
